predecessors.name: Republic of Yemen
predecessors.text: Aden, where 'STC-loyal forces seized the Yemeni government headquarters' on 28 January 2018

successors.name: Republic of Yemen
successors.text: the six southern governorates and Socotra, retaken by Presidential Leadership Council forces with Saudi backing from 2 to 7 January 2026

rulers.name: Aidarus al-Zoubaidi
rulers.title: Chairman; vice president of the Presidential Leadership Council from April 2022

ledger.x: Later in 2018: 'the group took parts of Lahij and Dhale'.
28 January 2018: the STC seizes government headquarters in Aden.
5 November 2019: the STC withdraws militarily from Aden under the Riyadh Agreement.
26 April 2020: self-governance declared and Aden's institutions occupied.
2-4 January 2026: Hadramawt and Al Mahrah retaken.

wars.name: Southern Transitional Council against the Hadi government
wars.outcome: 28 January 2018 the STC seized the government headquarters in Aden; fighting round Aden on 27-29 August 2019; the Riyadh Agreement of 5 November 2019; self-governance on 26 April 2020; the STC joined the Presidential Leadership Council in April 2022.

wars.name: Operation Promising Future and the Saudi-backed reversal
wars.outcome: 2 December 2025 the STC offensive in Hadramaut; 8 December control of most of former South Yemen; 2-4 January 2026 Hadramawt and Al-Mahrah retaken; 6-7 January Abyan and Shabwah; 7 January Aden; 9 January dissolution announced.

certainty.note: De facto control by a separatist council with no survey line; the governorate shapes are administrative proxies, and the page gives no extent for the 2018 Lahij and Dhale gains.
